title: Improved Techniques for Training Consistency Models
tldr_zh: 去掉 teacher EMA、换 Pseudo-Huber 与对数正态噪声调度，免蒸馏 CT 一步 FID 2.51（CIFAR-10），首次反超 CD。
tldr_en: Zero teacher EMA, Pseudo-Huber loss, lognormal noise schedule and exponential N curriculum let distillation-free CT reach one-step FID 2.51 on CIFAR-10, beating CD.
key_numbers: vs CD (LPIPS) 3.55 / 2.93 on CIFAR-10 and 6.20 / 4.70 on ImageNet-64 (Tables 2-3)
Pseudo-Huber c = 0.00054 sqrt(d), c = 0.03 optimal on CIFAR-10 (Fig. 2c)
N curriculum s0=10, s1=1280, exponential doubling (Eq. 9); FID vs N power law (Fig. 3a)
